notes.title: The Truck Game 2022 Halloween Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34307744/d506aaaa7b7bf493a30e5d322474c7b9d081c457.png[/img]

[h1]Happy Halloween, Everyone![/h1]

[h3]We brought back everything you loved about last year's Halloween Event, plus a new character and a new achievement![/h3]

[h3]We hope you enjoy this year's event![/h3]

[h3]Jim & Mike[/h3]

notes.title: Update notes for February 7, 2022 release
notes.content:
Turned off the Christmas Event.
Added clickable pigs to the Payloader mission!

notes.title: Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays Truckers.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34307744/fcad95f8a83465bcee97f2644ed5ac5a94069eba.png[/img]

[h1]Christmas has arrived in The Truck Game![/h1]

[list]
[*] We've updated every truck mission with Christmas decorations!
[*] We've added eight (8) new Christmas-themed achievements!
[*] And there is Christmas-themed music throughout, and a new Christmas puzzle!
[/list]
 
But, while we love the sights and sounds of Christmas, we'd like to suggest that the true Secret of Christmas is something more. Instead of all the gifts and candy canes and gingerbread cookies, it's the spirit of acceptance, empathy, and understanding of our fellow citizens of Earth. It's something we can aspire to all year long.
        
It may seem trivial in today's world. But, our fondest wish for you and yours is a Happy Holiday Season and for 2022 to be a year of worldwide peaceful coexistence.

Jim and Mike

notes.title: The Truck Game: Post-Halloween Release
notes.content:
We hope you enjoyed our 2021 Halloween Event as much as we enjoyed making it for you!  And you can be sure it'll be back next year!

For now, The Truck Game is back in "regular mode", with some sweet updates:
[list]
[*] New Clickables: Chickens! Barn! Flowers! And more!
[*] Brand new Crane Mission Puzzle
[*] The game now launches in Full Screen mode!
[/list]
But note: there's a secret hotkey, F, if you want to toggle between windowed and full screen mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34307744/06cf0588e22b39d00bd22e9210624f8a1633af1e.png[/img]

notes.title: Truck or Treat!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34307744/cd7cd1540b4e7d9e666662762cf427155fcbef46.png[/img]

[h2]Event Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*]Three (3) new Halloween-themed achievements!  Click bats, spiders, and jack-o-lanterns in each mission!  Collect them all!
[*]Three (3) new Halloween-themed puzzles in the Forklift, Payloader, and Crane missions.
[*]Halloween-themed Map Screen.  Spooky!
[*]Halloween-themed music!
[/list]
[h2]Additional Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]New and improved crane mission
[*]Updated environment art in the Dump truck/Excavator mission
[*]Updated Dog-catcher Truck
[/list]
Thanks!
[h3]Jim & Mike[/h3]
